quarterly_data.quarter: Micronics Japan annual securities report: FY2025 (03-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (January - December 2025) results: net sales JPY 70,173 million, up 26.1%; domestic sales JPY 5,161 million (up 24.5%) and overseas sales JPY 65,012 million (up 26.2%), an overseas ratio of 92.6%. Gross profit JPY 33,804 million, gross margin 48.2% (down 0.6 points); SG&A JPY 17,262 million (24.6% of sales, down 1.6 points); operating income JPY 16,542 million, up 31.6%; ordinary income JPY 17,100 million, up 39.6%; net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 12,063 million, up 36.9%. Management states the group steadily captured expanding HBM demand and memory probe cards performed strongly.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 70,173 million (+26.1%); operating income JPY 16,542 million (+31.6%); net income JPY 12,063 million (+36.9%); overseas ratio 92.6%

quarterly_data.quarter: Micronics Japan annual securities report: FY2025 (03-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Probe Card segment (probe cards that connect the tester to the chips on the wafer in wafer test): FY2025 sales JPY 68,525 million, up 28.0%; segment profit JPY 20,844 million, up 23.5%. Management states it captured HBM demand, which kept expanding from the prior year; in NAND flash, device prices rose on tighter supply and demand but the recovery in probe card demand stayed slow; in non-memory, the automotive semiconductor recovery was later than expected, but its non-memory probe cards held firm as it pursued new customers. Its memory probe cards currently hold a market advantage, and over the medium to long term it aims to grow non-memory probe card sales. TE segment (testers, manual / semi-automatic wafer probers, package probes / test sockets): sales JPY 1,648 million, down 22.1%; segment loss JPY 892 million against a JPY 1,191 million loss a year earlier; package probes contributed stable sales, and it is developing and marketing the new tester Testalio and the manual prober Excelyze. Production at selling prices: Probe Card JPY 73,911 million (127.1% of the prior year), TE JPY 1,442 million (79.3%), total JPY 75,354 million (125.6%).
quarterly_data.figure: Probe Card sales JPY 68,525 million (+28.0%), segment profit JPY 20,844 million (+23.5%); TE sales JPY 1,648 million (-22.1%), segment loss JPY 892 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Micronics Japan annual securities report: FY2025 (03-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management's view of the FY2025 market: generative AI kept data-center investment strong, with particularly strong demand for GPUs, HBM and commodity DRAM; in NAND flash, data-center demand grew but capacity additions were cautious on concern over a worsening supply-demand balance; in non-memory, AI advanced processes were firm while automotive and industrial chips still felt inventory adjustment, so the short-term recovery was limited. As the middle year of its FV26 medium-term plan, it invested actively in the new building at the Aomori Plant and in R&D to strengthen production capacity and create new technology, pushed sales of MEMS-type probe cards in non-memory, and strengthened customer relationships for new TE semiconductor-test products.

quarterly_data.quarter: Micronics Japan annual securities report: FY2025 (03-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 capital expenditure totalled JPY 15,252 million, to raise product performance, rationalise production, mass-produce new products and expand capacity; the main items were production equipment at the Aomori Plant and the Oita Technology Laboratory (JPY 9,781 million) and production equipment at the Korean subsidiary (JPY 1,155 million). Planned new facilities (Probe Card segment, all starting January 2026 and due for completion in December 2026): Aomori Plant (Hirakawa, Aomori) new-product manufacturing and capacity-expansion equipment, JPY 7,744 million; Aomori Plant building fixtures for the capacity expansion, JPY 2,914 million; MEK Co., Ltd. head-office plant (Bucheon, Gyeonggi-do, Korea) capacity-expansion equipment, JPY 4,041 million. The company does not state the added capacity, saying it is difficult to calculate reasonably.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 capex JPY 15,252 million; 2026 plans JPY 7,744 million + JPY 2,914 million (Aomori) and JPY 4,041 million (MEK, Korea), January - December 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Micronics Japan annual securities report: FY2025 (03-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term management plan FV26 targets for its final year (fiscal year ending December 2026), revised upward in November 2024: net sales JPY 80 billion, operating income JPY 20 billion, operating margin 25%, ROE 23%, assuming the probe card market grows at a 20% CAGR over 2024-2026 and an average exchange rate of USD 1 = JPY 147 over the three years; the report's materiality table also sets capex of JPY 48 billion and R&D of JPY 22 billion in total for 2023-2026. Key measures: grow faster than the market; in memory probe cards, keep its overwhelming No. 1 share through more production capacity and new technology; in non-memory probe cards, expand share by launching new MEMS-type products; in TE, build the contactor business into a stable earnings source, grow with new products for semiconductor test, and make field support (post-sales) a third revenue source.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 targets: net sales JPY 80 billion, operating income JPY 20 billion, operating margin 25%, ROE 23%; 2023-2026 capex JPY 48 billion
